title: Capacity model and headroom report
description: Versioned capacity model per tenant database and shared component with current utilization, forecast from volume drivers, headroom against benchmarked sustainable capacity, and actions triggered.

title: Per-tenant resource quota configuration and breach log
description: Configured connection, compute and rate limits per tenant and per agent identity, with events when limits are reached.

title: Load and surge test report
description: Reproducible load test results on the selected managed PostgreSQL modelling the largest expected sponsor at 10x normal grant volume, historical replay and projection rebuild, with p50/p95/p99 latencies, commit rate, outbox dispatch lag and pass/fail against thresholds.

title: Performance SLO report
description: Per-capability latency and throughput against published SLOs, from real-user monitoring segmented by device class and network quality and from server-side metrics.

title: Batch schedule and cut-off adherence log
description: Schedule of batch jobs (payment file generation, statements, receipts, reconciliation) with actual start and finish times, comparison to rail and business cut-offs, and any misses.
